Lytton Strachey, Queen Victoria.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/lytton-strachey/queen-victoria

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Lytton Strachey, the author, died 1932.

First publication of the text used: 1921 (SE colophon: 'Queen Victoria was published in 1921 by Lytton Strachey.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1921, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2016.
- Country of origin (the facts do not name the country of first publication; the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1932, so the text is public domain in each of them from 1 January 2003 at the latest.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
